hook: PHFI public health institute in Hyderabad gets a *June 2, 2028* deadline
hook_b: PHFI public health institute in Hyderabad gets a *June 2, 2028* deadline
tldr: CM A Revanth Reddy laid the foundation stone for the Public Health Foundation of India's Institute of Public Health Sciences in Hyderabad on November 14 and unveiled its campus master plan.

beats.what: He set June 2, 2028, as the completion target and said he would act as the institute's brand ambassador.
beats.why: He said the state spends about ₹2,500 crore a year via Aarogyasri and the CM Relief Fund and ₹12,000 crore on building hospitals.
beats.care: The CM said TIMS Sanathnagar is open, other TIMS hospitals will be made operational soon, and a new Osmania General Hospital complex is being built.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Speaking to investors, he said there was no policy paralysis and his government had built on predecessors' policies.
